get_ssl_embedding_model_dino: get a pretrained DINO ResNet50 self-supervised embedding model with optional head projection
get_ssl_embedding_model_simclr: get a pretrained SimCLR ResNet50 self-supervised embedding model with MLP head
get_ssl_embedding_model_barlow: get a pretrained Barlow Twins ResNet50 self-supervised embedding model with projector head
create_DINOHead_projector: create a DINOHead MLP projector with configurable layers, batch norm, and bottleneck dimension
create_SimCLRHead_projector: create a SimCLRHead two-layer MLP projector for self-supervised contrastive learning
